baseline_models.mechanism: The rousing branch of بعث acts on both the sleep-state and settled-location branches of مرقد, so one interruption breaks stillness and emplacement together.

activation_trace.role: Stirring a stationary sleeper supplies the force that terminates the prior state.
Sleep and stillness supply the state from which the speakers experience abrupt removal.
Fixed residence supplies a spatial persistence that the rousing also overturns.

changed_reading.after: Who broke our settled stillness and displaced us from the place that had held us?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالُوا ... هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ... وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers move from emitted alarm to deictic recognition: a promise carried in messenger-speech is now verified through realization in action.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance makes bewilderment and recognition occur in one spoken turn.
A verbal commitment opens expectation and supplies the earlier future-oriented saying.
Realization in deed converts the prior promise from report into accomplished fact.
The carried saying and its carriers form the transmission link between promise and recognition.

changed_reading.before: The awakened speakers remember that the messengers predicted this.
changed_reading.after: Their first utterance crosses from shock into compelled verification: carried speech has become an event they inhabit.

baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinary bounded promise is overlaid by the split عدّ inventory: prior preparation and counted recurring time make هَٰذَا register arrival at a readied appointment.

activation_trace.role: A promise bounded by time or place supplies the appointment structure.
Preparing provisions for an event overlays the promised occurrence with prior readiness.
Counted and recurring time makes the recognition feel like arrival at a scheduled point.

changed_reading.before: This is the thing that was promised.
changed_reading.after: This is the prepared appointment whose counted time has now arrived.

context_deltas.mechanism: Explicit revival of the dead and the dead earth's production of grain recast the sleep-place as dormant ground; بعث becomes not only waking but life-bearing extraction from that ground.

activation_trace.role: Rousing dormant matter supplies the focus transition.
Sleep and stillness provide the dormant-state anchor that the context materializes.
Animate life supplies the positive pole of the stated dead-to-living reversal.
Loss of force and life identifies the focus repose as more than ordinary sleep.
Earth revived through vegetative life supplies the material analogy for renewed bodies.
Passage to the outside supplies the directional movement from enclosure to emergence.
A seed that sprouts makes dormant containment productive rather than merely inert.

structural_cues: 36:12 states the dead-to-life reversal before the focus scene.
36:33 repeats that reversal as dead ground yielding an extracted seed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revival, dead ground, outward extraction, and seed; I transfer that plant process to the relation between مرقد and بعث. A live alternative is that the agricultural scene proves capability without specifying how human emergence should be imagined.

changed_reading.before: The dead are described softly as sleepers who wake.
changed_reading.after: Death is compressed latency in a ground-site, and the awakening is a germinative emergence from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier accusation that the Merciful sent nothing and that the envoys lie returns with its polarity reversed: the awakened collective now joins the same divine title and messenger category to realized truth.

activation_trace.role: An audible denial supplies the earlier public speech that the focus answer reverses.
The mercy-title is the repeated agent-name linking denial to later recognition.
The contrary of truth supplies the precise polarity that the focus declaration overturns.
The envoys' carried message supplies the disputed claim later verified.
The later collective utterance makes the reversal public in the speakers' own words.
Fulfillment in action converts the earlier charge of lying into acknowledged verification.
The same messenger category closes the denial-to-confirmation circuit.

structural_cues: 36:15 and 36:52 repeat the Merciful-plus-messenger vocabulary with opposite truth assessments.
The focus turn moves directly from an alarmed question to an unprompted acknowledgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical reversal; I read it as dialogic recantation without requiring the speakers in 36:15 and 36:52 to be the same historical individuals. The alternative is a thematic echo across different collectives.

changed_reading.before: The awakened people recall that a prediction was accurate.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages public recantation: the surah's vocabulary of denial returns as self-indicting confirmation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recorded obligation, exhaustive counting, calibrated celestial courses, the challenge of when, and the announced day form a scheduling system around the split عدّ branches of وعد; the focus deictic marks execution of that system.

activation_trace.role: The time-bounded promise supplies the explicit appointment in the focus.
Readiness prepared for an event overlays the appointment with prior provisioning.
Counted recurring time turns the promise into an awaited temporal threshold.
An inscription that fixes an obligating determination supplies the durable register behind the appointment.
Exhaustive numerical accounting supplies the counted dimension of the promised reckoning.
Measured governance of a course supplies the scheduling model at cosmic scale.
Assigning stages until a limit supplies a visible sequence of bounded intervals.
The challenged promise foregrounds the disputed arrival-time that the focus later recognizes.
A delimited day supplies the now-present execution interval immediately after the focus.

structural_cues: 36:12 records and enumerates before 36:38-40 displays measured courses.
The when-question of 36:48 becomes the this-recognition of 36:52 and the today of 36:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accounting, calibration, temporal challenge, recognition, and a delimited day; I connect them as one appointment system and let the split عدّ inventory sharpen that connection. The live alternative is that these are separate assurances of knowledge and power rather than one schedule.

changed_reading.before: A prediction has finally come true.
changed_reading.after: A prepared and enumerated appointment has reached its execution point, turning disputed future time into this present day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The horn-blast releases people in rapid motion from fixed graves, then recombines the dispersed population into complete presence; the focus is the startled speech inside a compulsory mobilization process.

activation_trace.role: A group surging and proceeding supplies the collective motion latent in the focus rousing.
Fixed residence supplies the stationary sites from which the population is displaced.
Joining dispersed elements supplies the forecast endpoint of collective convergence.
Near, witnessed presence supplies the destination of the movement.
Sending air into an object supplies the initiating physical action before emergence.
The blown horn supplies the instrument that converts signal into mobilization.
The grave supplies the concrete enclosure resolved by the focus sleeping-place.
Rapid forward motion supplies the speed and lack of deliberation in the released crowd.
Completion without dispersal supplies the all-at-once collective result.
Brought-near presence closes the movement from separated resting sites.

structural_cues: The focus is enclosed by emergence in 36:51 and complete presence in 36:53.
36:32 forecasts the same gathered-and-present endpoint well before the scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blast, horn, graves, rapid movement, gathering, and presence; I supply the causal chain signal to release to convergence. An alternative reads these as adjacent descriptions without emphasizing a single mobilization mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Individual sleepers wake and ask what happened.
changed_reading.after: A dispersed population is forcibly mobilized from fixed sites and converged into witnessed presence, speaking while in transit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy preserves and grants use only to a term, while promise can include both hoped-for good and threat; therefore naming the Merciful at fulfillment marks reliable governance, not automatic exemption from the accounting that follows.

activation_trace.role: Compassionate preservation supplies rescue as the source of continued life.
Extended preservation supplies mercy's bounded continuation rather than permanent escape.
The proper time of a thing supplies the limit at which preservation gives way to fulfillment.
The mercy-title anchors the fulfillment in compassionate agency even as sorting remains ahead.
A commitment that may concern good or evil keeps the recognized fulfillment outcome-neutral at first.
Matching action with recompense supplies the adjudicative function immediately following emergence.
A threat-specific promise confirms that fulfillment can expose rather than remove warned harm.

structural_cues: 36:44 joins mercy to enjoyment only until a term.
36:54 begins recompense immediately after the focus, and 36:63 identifies a threatened destination as promised.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded preservation, a promise range that includes threat, and subsequent recompense; I infer that the divine title governs the whole reliable sequence rather than predetermining every speaker's favorable outcome. The alternative is that the focus recognition is emotionally reassuring before later groups are distinguished.

changed_reading.before: The Merciful's promise is recognized as straightforward reassurance.
changed_reading.after: The Merciful's promise is recognized as trustworthy fulfillment: preservation reached its term, and mercy does not erase the warned accounting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives the awakened their own spoken acknowledgment, but the later sealing of mouths and transfer of intelligible testimony to limbs shows a truth process that can remove control of the speaking channel.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary voiced utterance supplies the speakers' initial channel of acknowledgment.
Truthful speech supplies the content they concede before testimony changes channels.
A securing seal blocks the ordinary speech channel and removes discretionary narration.
The mouth opened for speech supplies the normal channel whose closure makes the transfer visible.
Intelligible speech connecting interlocutors supplies agency to the hands after mouths are sealed.
Evidence stated from knowledge supplies the feet's independent verification.

structural_cues: 36:52 permits verbal acknowledgment; 36:65 later seals mouths while hands speak and feet testify.
Both scenes occur inside the post-gathering accounting sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the change of speaking organs; I read it as continuity in an evidentiary process that begins with the focus concession. The alternative is that the focus utterance and bodily testimony serve separate dramatic functions.

changed_reading.before: The people voluntarily admit that the messengers spoke truth.
changed_reading.after: Their admission opens a tribunal in which truth no longer depends on the account their mouths choose to give.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command-saying-being sequence supplies an efficient cause for the recognized fulfillment: messenger-speech carries the promise, while authoritative speech terminates the chain by making the promised state occur.

activation_trace.role: The prior verbal commitment supplies the future state awaiting realization.
Carriers of a saying supply the communicative middle of the causal chain.
Fulfillment by action supplies the focus transition from message to actuality.
An authoritative and obligating command supplies the initiating force of realization.
Emitted speech supplies the operative form through which the command is expressed.
Occurrence in time supplies the immediate realized result of the uttered command.

structural_cues: The surah closes by compressing intention, command, saying, and occurrence into one sequence.
The focus already joins promise, messenger-speech, and realization but leaves the efficient arrow unstated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies saying followed by occurrence in 36:82; I project that causal grammar backward onto the promise fulfilled in 36:52. The alternative is that 36:82 states general creative capacity rather than the specific mechanism of this resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The messengers accurately forecast an independently occurring event.
changed_reading.after: Their carried message is vindicated when authoritative speech actualizes the promised state, so saying and event form one causal chain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the anatomical womb branch of the divine title and the vessel branch of مرقد rather than their ordinary readings. It remains anchored to الرحمن, مرقد, and بعث and is reinforced by seed-emergence, offspring-like slipping out, the seminal drop, and renewed origination. Render it only as a gestational analogy for protected latency and release, never as a claim that either focus word literally means womb.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a house of growth supplies a protected enclosure-to-birth overlay for the divine title.
A sealed coated vessel supplies the unusual container-image for the sleeping-place.
Stirring dormant contents supplies the transition from containment to active emergence.
A germinating seed supplies a compact life-form released from dead ground.
Offspring and lineage supply the birth-like register of the emerging population.
Slipping free and separating supplies the actual motion out of enclosure.
The seminal drop supplies the first-creation precedent for life developing from contained small matter.
Bringing a thing newly into existence supplies the repeatable origination that supports second emergence.
Gestation and arising pregnancy reinforce the birth analogy while keeping it exploratory.

changed_reading.before: The Merciful wakes people from their graves.
changed_reading.after: The Merciful releases a population from a second protected latency, as though the grave had functioned analogically as a gestational vessel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant قلل mapping under قالوا to hear bodily instability inside ordinary speech. It remains anchored to the focus utterance and to the transition from settled repose into blast-driven rapid motion. Downstream prose should call it an acoustic-affective overlay, not translate قالوا as 'they trembled.'

activation_trace.role: Tremor from fear supplies an affective vibration beneath the speakers' alarmed utterance.
Instability and movement supply the bodily disorientation accompanying the spoken question.
Fixed residence supplies the stability whose loss is registered in the utterance.
A frightening cry supplies the acoustic shock that destabilizes the crowd.
Rapid forward movement supplies the bodily acceleration within which the speech occurs.

changed_reading.before: قالوا merely introduces what the awakened people say.
changed_reading.after: The collective saying also registers a crowd physically and affectively shaken out of stability by the summons.

strongest_changes: The sleep metaphor becomes a material emergence: dead ground yields life, fixed graves release rapid motion, and dispersed bodies converge into presence.
Earlier denial that the Merciful sent messengers reverses into the awakened speakers' own verification of those messengers.
The promise becomes a prepared, enumerated appointment and then an executed command within an accounting process.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet connected the focus roots into a functional sequence of dormant containment, timed release, compelled convergence, and truth moving from disputed message to realized event and embodied evidence. Split mappings preserved counted-appointment, gestational, and shaken-speech overlays that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The denial-to-recantation model does not require certainty that the earlier town speakers and the awakened collective are the same historical persons.
The عدّ overlay under وعد is packet-authorized but should sharpen scheduling rather than replace the ordinary promise sense.
The gestational and shaken-speech outliers are cross-domain overlays, not direct lexical translations.
